purpose_context: doc-kitty is structure-first and has never been installed or built. This mission first makes the repo provably green locally (install, test, example build on Node 22 with a committed lockfile), then wires path-scoped GitHub Actions lanes so a doc-only PR skips code checks and a code-only PR skips the doc build, deploys the example site to GitHub Pages from mainline, and adds a gated nightly smoke check of the live site. It is the delivery harness every later feature lands on.
purpose_tldr: A path-efficient CI/CD pipeline that gates PRs with one aggregate check, deploys the example site from mainline, and only runs the lanes a change can affect.
